messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, Stakeholder Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Human Impact Group Team,

Your exclusive focus on energy-transition infrastructure and retained search makes this a relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with a portfolio spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy and executive communications. My current work also intersects with large-scale renewable-energy and battery-storage investments.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership roles where responsible development, regulatory coordination, stakeholder trust and energy-transition execution must work together. I am internationally mobile for suitable global appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
